highlights: Yesido MG43 Digital Food Scale is a smart kitchen electronic scale designed to deliver accurate, reliable, and effortless weighing for everyday cooking, baking, and meal preparation.
High-Strength Tempered Glass Platform combined with a durable ABS body ensures long-lasting performance while maintaining a sleek, modern appearance that fits seamlessly into any kitchen.
Four-Point High-Precision Sensor System provides stable and accurate measurements, ensuring consistent weighing results for both small ingredients and larger portions.
Wide Weighing Range from 1g to 5000g makes the scale suitable for a variety of kitchen tasks, from precise spice measurements to bulk ingredient weighing.
Fine 1g Graduation Accuracy allows precise control over ingredient portions, supporting better recipe results and dietary management.
Clear LCD Display Screen ensures easy-to-read measurements at a glance, improving usability in both bright and low-light kitchen environments.
Multiple Measurement Units Supported including kg, g, oz, and lb:oz, offering flexibility for international recipes and different cooking preferences.
Overload Protection & Safety Alerts with “Err” overload indication and “LO” low battery warning help protect the scale and ensure reliable operation.
Compact & Slim Glass Design with a low-profile structure makes it easy to store in drawers or cabinets when not in use.
Battery-Powered Convenience operates on standard AAA batteries, providing portable and cordless use without the need for constant charging.
